title: Research on paper
when: Paired measured series, clearly identified intervals and restrained explanatory inserts
rules: Keep observations charcoal and a comparator orange on a white field.
Use sparse grids, a stable native key and explicit units; do not reproduce dense dual axes without necessity.
A translucent interval must have an explicit meaning and exact date boundaries.
Move emphasis, not the numerical scale; never let perspective imply a financial amount.
Pair any physical interpretation with native factual text and a qualitative limitation.
